comparison.objective: Sort colored cubes while yielding both arms whenever a person’s hand occupies a shared bin; unlike adjusting and validating a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pick-and-place, human-motion monitoring, separation maintenance, interruption, and resumption. It lacks physical adjustment, tool engagement, force-limited locking, and impact-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Each correctly sorted cube earns 0.25, but any gripper entering the bin or approaching the hand within 10 cm during occupancy zeros the trial. No structured spec version is present; the body provides scoring and timing but omits full setup dimensions and formal fidelity/reset fields.
comparison.reason: This record tests temporal human-aware collision avoidance during sorting, a meaningfully different ability from manipulating, locking, and dynamically commissioning a damper; the missing structured rubric details do not create plausible duplication.
